This is correct, these should behave the same as `get_shader_parameter_list()` which also uses `FUNC2SC()`. If we don't sync the command queue then there is no guarantee the list is populated before it is accessed in the calling function. 

I think this slipped through since generally we return data instead of modifying one of the arguments. Any function that returns data automatically synchronizes (the R suffix enforces synchronization too).
